text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Chronic Obstructive Pulmonary Disease (COPD) with Emphysema. Given your 20-year smoking history, the X-ray findings of hyperinflated lungs, and the progressive shortness of breath on exertion without wheezing, the clinical picture strongly supports a diagnosis of COPD.
